ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for export all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.

input.comment: [Playbook] Section 10 ends access and settles Deliverables and refunds but gives us no exit help or route to recover Customer Data, and Section 16.5 defers Customer Data to a Section 11 that does not exist in this Agreement. We have added our standard exit clause: up to six months of transition assistance at your then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter; if six months is difficult we can accept 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day export.
input.summary: Insert new Section 10.3 requiring up to 6 months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Customer Data in machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter.
